assertion.rationale: F4: layer-06 and layer-07 workflows cat their deployment manifests directly into $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY and upload them as artifacts. Job summaries and artifacts on a public repo are readable without authentication, so the App Insights connection string (whose ingestion key alone authorises telemetry writes), the Key Vault URI, SQL server FQDN, cost-export storage resource ID, Log Analytics customer ID, and the subscription ID embedded in every resource ID all flow to an uncontrolled, unauthenticated public surface with no approved authorization for that flow.

recommendation: Delete the appInsightsConnectionString Bicep output — nothing consumes it (apps/main.bicep:218-221 reads the component as existing). Stop cat-ing the full manifest into the job summary; summarise only non-sensitive selected keys. Drop the artifact upload.
